prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night just after rain in a 1930s town square: wet cobbles, iron streetlamps, an ultramarine sky with a small red moon. A long lens from the back of a crowd of young and old, men and women, Black, white and South Asian: their dark hats and shoulders are silhouettes across the near foreground. Beyond them, off-centre, an iron bandstand ringed with bare bulbs, where a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat with a gold chain and a black magician's cape, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache flings up one arm in a burst of white magician's flash and a billowing cloud of smoke. Through the thinning edge of the smoke, behind the bandstand, a columned stone building with a blank pediment and no lettering, its big door ajar and spilling gold light, with gangsters in pinstripe suits tiptoeing down its steps with fat sacks over their shoulders. The flash throws hard white light and long shadows across the crowd and streaks on the wet cobbles. Most of the frame in deep shadow; the brightest value is the flash, the second the bank's gold doorway. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
